name: Castle Keep
summary: A sign-up page where a castle builds itself stone by stone as your password gets stronger
about: A full sign-up page for a savings app where password strength is shown as a castle. Each rule you meet adds a stage: foundation, walls, towers, gate and moat, then a flag and fireworks, and it crumbles back if the password gets weaker. A little guard knight watches you type, lowers his visor for your password and salutes when the account is created.
how: Fill in your name and email while the knight follows the caret with his helmet
Type a password: the checklist ticks off rules and the castle grows from rubble to a full fortress
Focus a password field and the knight lowers his visor; press Show password and he lifts it a little to peek
Create account checks every field, then lowers the drawbridge as a progress bar
On success the gate opens, banners unfurl and the knight blows his trumpet; taken@demo.pk shows the error state
Start over clears the form and the castle tumbles back to rubble
